resources.string: After screen sharing is authorized, recognition runs with the window hidden. A complete recognized or uniquely predicted sequence appears once per round. Tap × to hide it while recognition continues, or show it from the notification.

After sharing your screen, tap the floating icon to start recognition. With automatic hiding off, × stops recognition and returns to the icon. Standby does not process frames or text; screen-sharing authorization stays active.
Standby. Tap the floating icon to start recognition.
Standby. The floating icon is hidden; restore it from the home screen.
Recognition is stopped. Tap the floating icon when you are ready.
Screen sharing remains authorized. Tap the icon to recognize; use Stop in this notification or the app to end sharing.
The window is hidden. Recognition continues in the background; a complete result appears automatically once per round. You can also show the window from the notification.
Recognition continues with the window hidden. Results appear once per round; tap Show floating window to open it now.
When the game confirms drawing is complete, hide the window and keep recognizing the next round. The top control row is hidden; use the notification to show the window or stop recognition.
